name: tasks
title: A plan outside the model's context (goal, steps, notes)
description: Keeps an agent's plan outside its context, in the project folder mounted writable at /work, so that a small local model keeps its goal after a compaction or a restart and does not repeat a mistake: set_goal, add_steps, remove_step, start_step, complete_step (with a note of what was done), block_step (with the reason), add_note (facts and mistakes not to repeat), next_step (the one step to work on now, with the goal, its notes, the last result and the latest notes), list_steps and progress (compact). Stored in /work/.tasks/plan.json, with a readable /work/.tasks/PLAN.md for the human; every change is locked and written atomically, so several connections can share one plan. No tool takes a path; sizes are bounded. No network.

mounts.description: The project folder, writable (--mount /work=PROJECT:rw): the plan goes to PROJECT/.tasks

notes: The plan is plain JSON with a Markdown copy beside it: read PROJECT/.tasks/PLAN.md to see what the agent is doing; edit plan.json only while no agent works on it (a plan the server cannot read is refused, never overwritten). The agent can also write .tasks with its own tools: the server checks every field it reads. What is stored was written by the model, often from what it read: data, not instructions.
